name: Supervised learning and experimental setup
title: Supervised learning and experimental setup: how a result is produced and what it owes you
blurb: The part of an experimental paper most readers skip and most reviewers read first. This section builds the supervised setup from scratch — labelled examples, features and targets, the hypothesis class, and the gap between fitting the data you have and generalising to data you do not. It then takes apart the three-way split, cross-validation, the parameter/hyperparameter distinction, and the contract every results table is supposed to honour. By the end you can tell a real number from a manufactured one.
skip_hint: If you can say why a score obtained on the test set can no longer be reported as a test score, and what a k-fold average estimates, skip this section.
